effect.name: Shadert0y
effect.description: Runs a Shadertoy-style GLSL script offscreen via OpenGL, with file slots, custom iParams, and alpha control.
effect.author: HyperDev

parameter.name: Script File
parameter.comment: Select the main .glsl or .frag file. If empty, a default color shader is used.

parameter.name: Speed
parameter.comment: Time multiplier. Negative values reverse time.

parameter.name: Flip Video Y
parameter.comment: Flip input video vertically.

parameter.name: Use Shader Alpha
parameter.comment: Off = force alpha to 1.0 (opaque). On = keep the alpha written by the shader.

parameter.name: File 0
parameter.comment: Image, video, or basic .glsl buffer used when an iChannel is set to File 0.

parameter.name: File 1
parameter.comment: Image, video, or basic .glsl buffer used when an iChannel is set to File 1.

parameter.name: File 2
parameter.comment: Image, video, or basic .glsl buffer used when an iChannel is set to File 2.

parameter.name: File 3
parameter.comment: Image, video, or basic .glsl buffer used when an iChannel is set to File 3.

parameter.name: Mouse X
parameter.comment: Normalized mouse X. 0 = left.

parameter.name: Mouse Y
parameter.comment: Normalized mouse Y. 0 = bottom.

parameter.name: Render Width
parameter.comment: Internal shader render width (horizontal). 0 = use incoming frame width.

parameter.name: Render Height
parameter.comment: Internal shader render height (vertical). 0 = use incoming frame height.

parameter.name: iParam0
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam0. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam1
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam1. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam2
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam2. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam3
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam3. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam4
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam4. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam5
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam5. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam6
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam6. Can be keyframed.

parameter.name: iParam7
parameter.comment: Shader uniform iParam7. Can be keyframed.
